title: Music Songs: Spotify ▶ preview plays real audio on desktop
acceptance: Against production, on desktop Chrome or Safari, ▶ on a liked Spotify song in Music › Songs plays real audio from the start in the inline row player, without ticking the row, and a second ▶ stops the first.
Preconditions are recorded with the run: a Spotify Premium account, and Spotify reconnected with playback scope (a plain library reconnect shows "Reconnect Spotify for playback").
Spotify ▶ on iPhone Safari is out of scope: the Web Playback SDK has no supported mobile-browser path (see RF-126).
nextAction: After RF-92's Spotify expiry and playback triage, the owner runs the desktop ▶ check against production and records the result here. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Split from RF-172 by the owner on 2026-11-05, so that RF-172's Apple Music half can close inside the Apple Music testing window (ends around 2026-11-27). The owner reconnected Spotify on the test account the same day; playback scope and Premium were not confirmed.
